notes.title: Hotfix - Patch 0.8.4
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Another hotfix is here with some balance tweaks, UI improvements, and bug fixes:

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
🔹 Adjusted the resource cost to construct ships: they now cost 60 wood, 45 hemp, 45 flax, and 20 leather. This should make early expansion feel more balanced.
🔹 Faith, science, and trust are now displayed alongside other resources in the top panel.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
🔸 Updated the Discord link.
🔸 Fixed a bug where elder output was not displayed correctly.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the number of tribe members was displayed incorrectly on the tribe button after loading a saved game.
🔸 Fixed a bug that caused some tooltips to disappear too quickly or not stay on screen properly.

notes.title: Hotfix - Patch 0.8.2
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

A few small but meaningful improvements in today’s hotfix:

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
🔹 The game now automatically adapts to your screen resolution on startup.
🔹 Maps will no longer appear in Peculiarities if more than 90% of all land tiles are already visible.
🔹 Trust now increases for every villager transported to the next island.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
🔸 It’s no longer possible to leave the Peculiarity screen without selecting an option.
🔸 Fixed an issue where the info text on the main building would load twice.
🔸 Removed redundant text in the UI.
🔸 Fixed text overflow issues in some languages.
🔸 Resolved a localization bug in the tech tree.

notes.title: Hotfix - Patch 0.8.1
notes.content:

notes.title: Island Dwellers - Major gameplay update
notes.content:
Hello!

Huge thanks to everyone who tested the game and shared feedback — you’ve helped shape this update in a big way. Today, we’re introducing [b]two major features[/b] that enhance exploration, strategy, and the new player experience!

[h1]🔹1. Finite Resources[/h1]

The world just got a lot more dynamic. Every time a new map is generated, each tile now has a limited amount of resources based on its terrain type. This change makes exploration essential — your people will need to stay on the move to find food, materials, and survival opportunities.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Yl0hwDL.png[/img]
[i]🧭 When a unit is selected, nearby tiles now show exactly what resources are available and how much is left.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/q3RTyam.png[/img]
[i]🔨 The task panel also shows how many resources are left in the tooltip.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/d5kItrX.png[/img]
[i]🏠 Buildings make specific resources infinite, so setting up a village means your tribe can settle — for a while.[/i]

[h1]🔹2. New player guide[/h1]

A lightweight tutorial system now tracks whether you’ve performed key actions and will gently guide you only if you haven’t.

📘 Hit a milestone but missed a mechanic? The guide pops up only when needed, so veterans won’t get nagged, and new players don’t feel lost. Here is an example from the start of the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5GbTNe7.png[/img]
[i]Learn how to cycle between idle units with this early-game prompt.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/qsOS8Ps.png[/img]
[i]When selecting an idle unit, the tutorial shows how to move using the right mouse button.[/i]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/066X8cm.png[/img]
[i]After moving, the guide explains how to assign tasks to your units.[/i]

That’s all for now! As always, keep the feedback coming — every message helps make Island Dwellers better.
👉 Remember to wishlist and play the demo!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3023960/Island_Dwellers/
